decisions.title: Pivot architecture toward CAV pullback over attention heads
decisions.one_line: Redirect the project toward a live memory system using a larger model's attention heads (CAV pullback, QK/OV circuits) as relational operators.

decisions.title: Use attention heads only, discard the rest of the model
decisions.one_line: Commit to using only the attention heads as substrate, discarding the rest of the model, captured as a docs/theory note.

decisions.title: Download only Qwen 8B head-layer safetensors as substrate
decisions.one_line: Adopt Qwen 8B head-layer safetensors (downloaded in isolation) as the real, non-mock substrate.

decisions.title: Halt infrastructure drift, refocus on measured retrieval
decisions.one_line: User halts infrastructure expansion; work refocuses on improving the existing measured retrieval results.

decisions.title: Restrict the LLM slice to linker/inspector role
decisions.one_line: The LLM slice is a linker/inspector only; no token-level activation state is stored.

decisions.title: Pivot to performance optimization with a parallel-run rig
decisions.one_line: With benchmarks saturated, shift effort to performance optimization backed by a parallel-run rig.

decisions.title: Adopt heat-diffusion framing for the read stage
decisions.one_line: Adopt attention as a local transition operator (heat diffusion) for the read stage over attention links, and implement it.

decisions.title: Set 95% accuracy on long chats as the target
decisions.one_line: User sets 95% accuracy on long chats as the explicit optimization target for the campaign.

decisions.title: Retrench after Hebbian work shows zero evidence gain
decisions.one_line: Following a user reprimand, the assistant concedes the Hebbian work produced zero evidence gain and retrenches.

decisions.title: Make the operational end-to-end test primary
decisions.one_line: The operational end-to-end test (ingest a full conversation, answer from memory) becomes the primary test.

decisions.title: Define consolidation as live per-turn association/strengthening
decisions.one_line: Consolidation is redefined as live per-turn association/strengthening via subsequent prompts, mirroring decay, using Qwen activations.

decisions.title: Shift the target to the locked LongMemEval benchmark
decisions.one_line: The optimization target shifts from local 39-probe wins to the locked LongMemEval benchmark.

decisions.title: Fix step 4 with partition-local search
decisions.one_line: Step 4 (global-pool filtering) is identified as the weak spot; a partition-local search fix is ordered.

decisions.title: Adopt two-hop attention-guided retrieval
decisions.one_line: Two-hop retrieval (attention against recalled evidence, then re-retrieval) is adopted over recursive reranking.

decisions.title: Refine two-hop into recurrent CAV activation
decisions.one_line: Two-hop retrieval is refined into recurrent CAV: initial search activations augmented with retrieved evidence.

decisions.title: Reframe success as beating 1M-token full-context retrieval
decisions.one_line: Success is reframed as beating 1M-token full-context retrieval, with the system as context provider (never answerer); the user then locks 1M single-transcript retrieval as the concrete benchmark.

decisions.title: Adopt TF-ISF activation with minimal HSC layer
decisions.one_line: Adopt TF-ISF activation plus a minimal provenance-preserving HSC layer for packet compression.

decisions.title: Defer SOM to a later ablation
decisions.one_line: The SOM compression arm is deferred to a later ablation rather than built now.

decisions.title: Choose four-slot HSC channel and reversible pruning
decisions.one_line: Four-slot HSC channel chosen over eight-slot after displacement evidence; query-conditioned reversible pruning chosen over aggressive deletion.

decisions.title: Adopt the information-bottleneck greedy channel packer
decisions.one_line: An information-bottleneck greedy channel packer is adopted as an opt-in post-retrieval stage.

decisions.title: Run the operational transcript-replacement test via the central-dev gateway
decisions.one_line: Commit the tree and run the operational transcript-replacement test via the central-dev codex_sdk LiteLLM gateway instead of an Anthropic key.

decisions.title: Reject the two-partition routing arm
decisions.one_line: The two-partition routing arm is rejected: 86.3% coverage falls below the simpler role-aware baseline's 93%.

decisions.title: Freeze answer generation; make reachability the objective
decisions.one_line: Answer generation is frozen; complete-set reachability inside the correct history is declared the objective and the weakest link.

decisions.title: Build a minimal CAV event/concept-link reachability layer
decisions.one_line: Build a minimal CAV event/concept-link reachability layer, with deterministic extraction as the control arm.

decisions.title: Abandon QK/OV operator construction for marginal set selection
decisions.one_line: QK/OV activation-operator construction is abandoned in favor of simpler query-conditioned marginal set selection.

decisions.title: Replace JSON with INI for the selector protocol
decisions.one_line: The INI exchange format replaces JSON for the small-model selector protocol (after 'ini' was initially misread as INT8).

decisions.title: Restore the six-layer Qwen3-8B prefix QK/OV architecture
decisions.one_line: Drift correction: stop the full 0.6B generator ablation and restore the intended six-layer Qwen3-8B prefix QK/OV architecture.

decisions.title: Adopt staged GPU residency
decisions.one_line: Remove the BGE-on-CPU defensive rule and adopt staged GPU residency (BGE then Qwen prefix).

decisions.title: Use closure-aware RAG for diffuse retrieval
decisions.one_line: Diffuse retrieval will use closure-aware RAG (discourse graph plus evidence obligations), not vanilla top-k RAG.

decisions.title: Reorganize the codebase into objects, transformations, workflows
decisions.one_line: The codebase is reorganized as immutable objects -> pure transformations -> stateful workflows/adapters.

decisions.title: Reject EM-LLM as a dependency
decisions.one_line: EM-LLM is rejected as a dependency; only surprise-based segmentation and boundary techniques are borrowed.

decisions.title: Reuse existing surprise/attention-head machinery
decisions.one_line: Reuse the existing surprise/attention-head machinery instead of reimplementing EM-LLM algorithms.

decisions.title: Refuse a whole-codebase rewrite; refactor only replay/eval plumbing
decisions.one_line: No whole-codebase rewrite; only a targeted refactor of the concentrated replay/eval plumbing.

decisions.title: Waive corpus and checkpoint blockers to run the 1M test
decisions.one_line: User waives corpus-blocked and checkpoint concerns ('controlled environment') to force the 1M test to run.

decisions.title: Re-lock the linear-cumulative 'ultimate' design
decisions.one_line: User halts drift and re-locks the linear-cumulative design: each retrieval method must nest on the previous; build and document the ultimate version.

decisions.title: Add LLM synthesis/rescoring of S1-S3 episodic evidence
decisions.one_line: Add LLM-based synthesis and rescoring of S1-S3 episodic evidence, using the litellm endpoint.

decisions.title: Drop exact validation rebuilds; streamline for speed
decisions.one_line: Exact validation rebuilds are dropped; keep only memory retrieval plus summarization against benchmarks, streamlined for fast runs.

decisions.title: Reinject CAV instead of recomputing it
decisions.one_line: The forgotten fourth layer is recovered from memory: reinject CAV instead of recomputing it.

decisions.title: Restore the Hebbian arm to the evaluation ladder
decisions.one_line: The Hebbian arm is discovered to have fallen out of the executable evaluation ladder; its restoration begins.

decisions.title: Clarify CAV as the linking/fusion layer over S0-S3
decisions.one_line: The design is clarified as layers of increasing complexity, with CAV as the linking/fusion layer over S0-S3 evidence, not a retrieval method.
